metadata.question: Was the land surface temperature in Needles, California higher than Phoenix, Arizona on June 21, 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to compare land surface temperature (LST) between two locations on a specific date - Use MODIS Terra LST (MOD11A1) or Landsat 8 Collection 2 Level 2 for surface temperature - Date: June 21, 2017 - Locations: Needles, California and Phoenix, Arizona 2. Masking strategy: - For MODIS LST: Use QA band to mask low-quality pixels - For Landsat: Use QA_PIXEL band to mask clouds - MODIS might be better for single-day comparison due to daily coverage 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid LST should be in reasonable range (e.g., 250-350K or 20-50°C for summer desert) - Check if images exist for both locations - Check if valid pixels remain after masking - Compare the two values and determine which is higher ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const needles = ee.Geometry.Point([-114.6142, 34.8481]); // Needles, CA const phoenix = ee.Geometry.Point([-112.0740, 33.4484]); // Phoenix, AZ const date = '2017-06-21'; // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Terra LST (daily coverage) const col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A1') .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) .select(['LST_Day_1km', 'QC_Day']); const colSize = await col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images found: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log('No MODIS data for June 21, 2017'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing - Get first image and apply QA mask const img = col.first(); // Mask based on QA (keep only good quality pixels: bits 0-1 = 00) const qa = img.select('QC_Day'); const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0); const lstMasked = img.select('LST_Day_1km').updateMask(mask).multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15); // Convert to Celsius // 4. Calculate LST for both locations const needlesStats = await lstMasked.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: needles, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const phoenixStats = await lstMasked.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: phoenix, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); // Check pixel counts const needlesCount = await lstMasked.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: needles.buffer(1000), scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const phoenixCount = await lstMasked.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: phoenix.buffer(1000), scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const needlesLST = needlesStats.LST_Day_1km; const phoenixLST = phoenixStats.LST_Day_1km; const needlesPx = needlesCount.LST_Day_1km; const phoenixPx = phoenixCount.LST_Day_1km; console.log(`Needles LST: ${needlesLST !== null ? needlesLST.toFixed(2) : 'null'}°C, Pixels: ${needlesPx || 0}`); console.log(`Phoenix LST: ${phoenixLST !== null ? phoenixLST.toFixed(2) : 'null'}°C, Pixels: ${phoenixPx || 0}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (needlesPx === 0 || phoenixPx === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after QA masking'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (needlesLST === null || phoenixLST === null || isNaN(needlesLST) || isNaN(phoenixLST)) { console.log('Invalid LST calculation'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (needlesLST < -50 || needlesLST > 100 || phoenixLST < -50 || phoenixLST > 100) { console.log('LST out of reasonable range'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (needlesLST > phoenixLST) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
